profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer  with a demonstrated history of working in the retail industry. Skilled in Python, Javascript, C++, and Ionic2. Strong professional with a Bachelor’s Degree focused in Computer Science from University of Kentucky. Very Self-driven individual who self-taught most programming languages that he knows. Very interested in app and web development.

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description:
Build and maintain websites hosted on both Linux and Windows web servers.
Develop using JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and PHP
Diagnose and repair hardware, software, and connectivity issues for office devices (including laptops, printers, telephones, and fax machines).
Maintain Sharepoint on Office365 for HDI

positions.title: Cashier Customer Service
positions.description: I was responsible with the "last impression" of customers leaving our store. As well as giving more services, such as assistance outside to those who wanted it.

educations.degreeName: Associate of Arts and Sciences (A.A.S.) With Computer Science focus

volunteerExperiences.role: Raise funds for children with Muscular Dystrophy for the Muscular Dystrophy Association (MDA)
volunteerExperiences.description: We raised money to send four kids to a special camp. I was one of the top 3 contributors to this cause.
